note: Independent re-judgment after BGP export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified RFC 8893 Section 3 ('When applied to egress policy, validation state MUST be determined using the effective origin AS of the route as it will (or would) be announced to the peer.'), all four cited producers, and both tagged tests. Export-chain next-hop unification propagated NextHopIntent across runPostEgressRPKIValidation and runEgressPolicyChainASN4 and replaced NextHopMode=NextHopUnchanged with BuiltinNextHopUnchanged in the live-forward tests without altering effective-origin computation or assertions. Q1: positive asserts the exact wire AS_PATH ([65000, 65001, 65000]) on live forward with as-override AND that the validator query's originAS equals the exact rightmost wire AS (65000), plus 2-octet AS_PATH + AS4_PATH 4-octet origin reconstruction (4200000100); negative asserts live forward rejects when stale received origin 65002 is authorized but effective announced origin 65000 is not, verifies validator never queried stale 65002 and did query 65000, and verifies withdrawals pass unblocked. Q2: querying the received origin AS or failing 2-octet/AS4_PATH reconstruction fails exact wire-AS, query-log, and accept/reject assertions. Q3: distinct VRPs for stale vs effective origin and explicit validator query recording isolate effective-origin selection. Q4: covers live wire announced origin, 2-octet AS4_PATH reconstruction, stale-origin refusal, and withdrawal passthrough.
